title.label: Pretty good although I think you should definitely read this

content.label: Ok, so this app is actually pretty good. You can make the card or invitation and than also make an online RSVP that people can log onto and fill out. Although you have to pay for the pro if you want some actually good options. Without the pro feature you only VERY limited options on what you can make and the templates as well as the stickers. You also have to create an account or else your projects will not save. I learned that the hard way. 😂 You can't just partly start the project and then exit the app or log off because then it won't save. Other than those reasons I like the app. There are no adds which I love because I can't stand adds. ( which I think a lot of people with agree with me on that) 😂 please consider my information before you download. Also I know that a lot of parents and kinds worry about giving you personal information away. This app has not information requirements and you make a fake username for the projects. You don't give any info to them or to be posted on the internet. I do recommend this app but beware of the payments and the limited supply. Along with the no saving if your not logged in. I really hope that they fix these problems soon. It's really annoying and almost made me delete the app. So please read my Review for better Info on this invitation making app. Thanks and please, pleaseee🙏🙏🙏🙏 update and make the app better or else I am going to delete this app, for future reference and a heads up. 😘🙂🥰
